If true Dcm will call ComM_DCM_ActiveDiagnostic(). Parameters (inout) None Parameters (out) None Return value Std_ReturnType E_OK: this value is always returned. Description Allows to activate and deactivate the call of ComM_DCM_ActiveDiagnostic() function. Available via Dcm.h
